Rule.Name: Ensure the TimeOut Is Set to 10 or Less (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: TimeOut directive is set higher than 10 seconds.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^TimeOut" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^TimeOut.*|TimeOut 10|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'TimeOut 10' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure KeepAlive Is Enabled (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Enable KeepAlive in the Apache configuration.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^#\?KeepAlive" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^#\?KeepAlive.*|KeepAlive On|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'KeepAlive On' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure MaxKeepAliveRequests is Set to 100 or Greater (Automated)
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^MaxKeepAliveRequests" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^MaxKeepAliveRequests.*|MaxKeepAliveRequests 100|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'MaxKeepAliveRequests 100' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure KeepAliveTimeout is Set to 15 or Less (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: KeepAliveTimeout is set higher than 15 seconds.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^KeepAliveTimeout" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^KeepAliveTimeout.*|KeepAliveTimeout 15|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'KeepAliveTimeout 15' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure Request Headers Timeout is Set to 40 or Less (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Timeout limits for request headers are set higher than 40 seconds.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set request header timeout to 40 seconds or less using mod_reqtimeout.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^RequestReadTimeout" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^RequestReadTimeout.*|RequestReadTimeout header=40|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'RequestReadTimeout header=40' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure Request Body Timeout is Set to 20 or Less (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Timeout limits for the request body are set higher than 20 seconds.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set request body timeout to 20 seconds or less using mod_reqtimeout.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^RequestReadTimeout body=" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^RequestReadTimeout body=.*|RequestReadTimeout body=20|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'RequestReadTimeout body=20' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 restart
